title: Fleet Vehicle Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Fleet Vehicle Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Fleet Vehicle Estimate Worksheet covers fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision. The fleet maintenance coordinator records Fleet Vehicle Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Fleet Vehicle Estimate Worksheet keeps Fleet Vehicle Service exceptions visible until the fleet maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fleet Vehicle Estimate Worksheet at fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point. Document fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision identity before Fleet Vehicle Service begins. Compare fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision findings with stated Fleet Vehicle Service criteria; route unresolved Fleet Vehicle Service issues to qualified fleet maintenance reviewer. For Fleet Vehicle Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Fleet Vehicle Service. Ask qualified fleet maintenance reviewer to review Fleet Vehicle Service conditions beyond the fleet maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Vehicle, customer, and estimate identity
sections.guidance: Identify the customer, asset or property, estimator, and basis date before pricing the work.

fields.label: Repair, claim, fleet, or dispatch ID

blocks.label: Fleet Vehicle Service identity

fields.label: Fleet unit, work order, and department
VIN, plate, mileage, engine hours, and assignment
Driver report, interval, prior defect, and campaign reference

blocks.guidance: Use the Fleet Vehicle Service identifier printed on fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision or its linked source record.

sections.title: Vehicle findings and pricing evidence
sections.guidance: Price the observable work and options. Keep concealed conditions and unconfirmed quantities out of fixed scope.

blocks.label: Fleet Vehicle Service scope observations
items: Parts, labor, downtime, and vendor status
Open campaign, recall, or recurring defect
blocks.guidance: Mark what was observed or supplied as estimate input; explain anything material that could not be inspected.

sections.title: Estimate exception and change conditions
sections.guidance: State what could change the price, timing, method, or scope before the customer or responsible party decides.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when safety, maintenance, repeat-defect, authorization, or return-to-service concern remains unresolved. Protect fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision; document the Fleet Vehicle Service notification and await qualified fleet maintenance reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Conditions that may require a revised estimate or specialist review
items: Safety defect or overdue critical service
Repair exceeds authority or downtime commitment
blocks.guidance: For Fleet Vehicle Service, identify affected fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision scope; ask fleet maintenance coordinator to document the Fleet Vehicle Service immediate control before continuing.

blocks.label: Assumptions, exclusions, access limits, allowances, and change-order terms

fields.label: Assumptions, exclusions, access limits, allowances, and change-order terms

sections.title: Estimate decision and selected repair scope
sections.guidance: Record the selected option and spending limit. Approval of an estimate authorizes only the stated scope and terms.

blocks.label: Estimate support retained
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision; mark only Fleet Vehicle Service evidence present in that record.
